plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Transfer Pathway to CSUB map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, the Transfer Pathway to CSUB, Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4). The same page's CSU Bakersfield continuation (Liberal Studies - Multiple Subject - Bachelor of Arts, 64 units, Terms 9-12) is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The program's other pathway, 'Bakersfield College Elementary Teacher Education Associate in Arts for Transfer' (also printed at 60-61.5 units, 4 terms), is a further pattern for the same AA-T credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the Bakersfield College degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 15-15.5 / 14-15 / 16 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'English' (3-3.5); Term 2 'Major List A' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. Named courses and slots printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' are recorded with category 'major' (the Term 1 'English' slot; EDUC B24 is printed 'Major'; CDEV C1000, COMM C1000, HIST B1, MATH B4A, BIOL C1000, the Term 2 'Major List A' slot, ERSC B10L, ERSC B10, PHSC B12, HIST C1001, the Term 3 'Major List B' slot, POLS C1000 and GEOG B5 are printed 'Major / Gen Ed'); ENGL C1002 and the Term 4 'Major List C' slot are printed 'Major'. ERSC B10L shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flag is disclosed on that course row. No other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in the Bakersfield College section. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan.'
